positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Designed, implemented, and tested strategies to automate the transfer of data governance information between two platforms using Python and Airflow
o	Expanded the visibility of information to 100% of the employees
o	Presented and demonstrated project achievements to the Customer Knowledge Platform teams

Established a process to send Slack and email alerts of severe SLA misses for data sets utilizing Python, Airflow, and PySpark
o	Improved employee response times in resolving issues by removing the responsibility of notifying employees of the miss

positions.title: Summer Instructor
positions.description: Taught students the basics of coding in week long summer camps in order to spark their interest in coding and encourage them to explore Computer Science concepts.

positions.title: Alumni
positions.description: Participated in the Summer Immersion Program, a 7-week experience that teaches girls to code in HTML, CSS, Javascript, and Python.

projects.title: ECO (Environmental Conservation Objective)
projects.description: A website developed with two other Girls Who Code alumni that includes two interactive games as well as informational pages to bring awareness to the degradation of the environment.
